verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe a finance team issuing instant virtual cards per software subscription with per-vendor spending limits. A community user independently reports spinning up a new expense card in under a minute. The agent-card docs also point to Virtual Cards for reusable merchant cases. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of virtual-card scoping controls (merchant/category locks, expiry, limits), explicit evidence of purpose/category scoping such as ad spend, and hands-on detail beyond a single marketing line.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor

citations.quote: A finance team issues instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits
I can click a few buttons and get a new business expense card spun up in less than a minute
use Virtual Cards for those reusable cases
